description: This file contains implementation of component management functions for a network management system, including setting boolean and string parameters, adding/removing instances, and fetching parameters via an external bus interface.

methods.name: int component_set_bool(const char * component,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus,const char * param,bool value)
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter for a specified component via external bus interface.

methods.name: int component_set_enable(const char * component,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus,bool enable)
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified component.

methods.name: char * component_get_path_instance(amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus,const char * query)
methods.description: Retrieves the data model path of an instance based on a query.

methods.name: char * component_add_instance(const char * object_path,amxc_var_t * parameter,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus)
methods.description: Adds a new instance of a component at a specified object path with provided parameters.

methods.name: int component_set_str_param(const char * component,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus,const char * param,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets a string parameter for a specified component.

methods.name: int component_del_instance(const char * object_path,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus)
methods.description: Deletes an instance identified by its object path.

methods.name: int component_get_param(amxc_var_t * ret_var,const char * component,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus,const char * parameter)
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specified parameter for a component.

methods.name: int component_add_string_to_csv(const char * component,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus,const char * parameter,const char * str)
methods.description: Adds a string to a CSV list parameter of a component.

methods.name: int component_remove_string_from_csv(const char * component,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus,const char * parameter,const char * str)
methods.description: Removes a string from a CSV list parameter of a component.

methods.name: int component_set_params(const char * component,amxb_bus_ctx_t * bus,amxc_var_t * values)
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters for a component at once.
